description: Read a dataset's rows from its newest run with rows (or a given run): each row's key, values, the page it came from, and whether it is new or changed in that run (the key opens its history with get_dataset_row_history). format 'markdown' answers a ready-to-show Markdown table; 'json' (default) the rows as data. Page through big datasets with offset and limit; search with q.

mark.description: Only rows new, changed or back in that run

q.description: Only rows with this text in any value, case insensitive

run.description: A run id from the dataset (default: the newest run with rows)

name: get_dataset_rows
title: Get dataset rows
